correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the full all-d>=4 proof for S_d: F=x1^d+x1*x2^(d-1)+x3^d-x4^d. The partial derivatives have no common projective zero in characteristic zero, proving smoothness. A line parametrized by four binary linear forms has pair ranks (r1,r2); rank-zero is impossible and mixed 1/2 ranks would force a degree-d separable binary divisor to equal a dth power. If both ranks are two, the root configurations of u^d+uv^(d-1) (0 plus (d−1)-st roots of -1) and z^d-w^d (unit dth roots) would be projectively equivalent. For d−1>=3, three unit roots determine the generalized unit circle while 0 lies off it, contradicting Möbius preservation of generalized circles. Hence both ranks are one: exactly d² lines x1=a x2, x3=b x4 with a^d+a=b^d-1=0. Separability and normal bundle O(2−d) give finite reduced etale line scheme. Rational roots give four for even d and one for odd d. Row/column incidence and adjunction yield matrix eigenvalues d (1), 0 (2d−2), −d ((d−1)²). Hyperplane class belongs to their span and Hodge index makes pairing nondegenerate on that span; its rank is (d−1)²+1, hence 36 geometric lines, 4 rational, rank26 at d6. Independent small-degree integer Kronecker matrices d4,5,6 had ranks10,17,26; these are corroboration of the uniform proof.
